summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing the repurchase of 1,000,000 ordinary shares on April 20, 2026, at a volume-weighted average price of 103.0323 pence per share from Goldman Sachs International as broker. The purchases are part of an existing share buyback programme announced on January 30, 2026, and the shares will be cancelled. This is an issuer tender/buyback for capital return purposes, not a self-tender offer. The buyback reduces share count and returns capital to shareholders. No takeover or strategic change is involved. Investors should monitor the pace of buyback completion and subsequent cancellation announcements.
